findings.summary: The tile change reached the vocabulary head, but compiled decoder projections retained 128-row tiles. The full-PDF result is flat; it does not test smaller tiles throughout the decoder.
observations: All three ordinary diagnostic calls and the separate complete instrumented call passed the frozen checks. NACA median is 2.979 s, including OCR 2.540 s and embedding 0.301 s; mean shares are 85.3% OCR and 10.1% embedding.

Each GPU records exactly 32 persistent matmul launches with 128-thread blocks during the 32-iteration capture. The remaining 3,747–4,080 persistent matmul launches use 256-thread blocks. Compiled QKV graph code still divides the runtime row count into 128-row tiles.

The vocabulary head executes outside the compiled decoder and reaches the smaller tile table. The decoder graph fixes the large tile selected during tracing. Fresh cache directories exclude reuse of the earlier default graph as the explanation.

This matches upstream issue #54243 about M-dependent invariant tile buckets collapsing during torch.compile tracing. Official vLLM documentation explains that one dynamically shaped graph is reused and warns against Python branching on the token count.

The candidate passed all 30 evaluator calls and 2,790 raw EOS completions. Against its fresh control, p50 speedup changed +0.74%, p95 −2.10%, and throughput −1.16%. The median difference is within earlier repeat variation.
OCR-window busy averages 63.9%, 60.0%, 72.8% and 71.6% on GPUs 0–3, with eight one-second samples each. These short samples do not establish peak compute or memory-bandwidth saturation.
decoder-kernel-execution.json retains block counts, kernel duration sums and trace paths. The capture includes vision prefill; these sums are not whole-call wall-time shares.
findings.next_step: Test a fixed 32-row tile for the screened BF16 decoder shapes so selection cannot depend on the traced token count. Verify compiled kernel launches and complete frozen outputs, then compare full-PDF latency with the fresh default control.
findings.optimization: Keep the reduction block, column tile, model precision, four GPUs and evaluator fixed. A constant row tile also affects prefill, so its full-PDF cost must be measured.
